Hi Natalie —

Thanks for starting the onboarding flow. Our systems show the vendor record for Zenworks is created, but we're blocked from issuing PO PO-78342 because the W9 did not attach successfully to the supplier profile. The vendor portal flagged the attachment as a "hash mismatch" during processing. I attached the W9 request we sent for reference.

Quick asks / next steps:
- Can you re-send the W9 as a reply to this thread (PDF scan preferred) or upload via the DocuSign link below? DocuSign is our preferred secure route: https://secure.docusign.redwood.ai/zenworks-w9

As soon as finance has the W9 on file we'll move PO-78342 to "Approved" and issue the payment terms. If the portal path continues to fail we'll provisionally raise a PO record so operations can proceed while engineering investigates.

Subject: RE: Zenworks onboarding: investigation notes + temporary fix ETA

Folks — quick update from infra/ingestion side (brief):

What I found:
- The portal ingestion pipeline computes an SHA256 over the uploaded payload and compares against the stored client-side digest. The failure is triggered when the computed digest does not match the received digest header.
- In the logs I see that some uploads originating from browsers that add a trailing newline to the content-disposition metadata cause the client-side digest header to include an extra line break in the canonicalization step. The server canonicalization used for verification did not mirror that exact step, leading to reproducible hash mismatches for a subset of uploads (edge-case). See attached csv-sanitizer-log-20270414.txt for the trace where the vendor filename contained a colon/newline in the metadata that normalized differently.

Short-term mitigation (now):
- We will accept the W9 PDF via the secure DocuSign ingestion path which performs whole-file storage (bypasses digest check). Lauren/Marissa, please advise vendors to use the DocuSign URL.
- I will deploy a small hotfix to the ingestion canonicalization so server-side canonicalization matches what browsers send. Target deploy window: 2027-04-15 03:00 UTC (low traffic). Rollback plan in place.

Longer-term:
- Add defensive normalization for filename/metadata and log a clearer error message to vendors (and return a remediation link).

If anyone needs the raw trace, it’s uploaded to ONBOARD-4321.

Karthik Iyer
Staff Software Engineer, Ingestion
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: csv-sanitizer-log-20270414.txt
